app.name: Pixvault
app.tagline: Image and file hosting for teams

theme.toggle: Light, dark or follow the system

login.title: Sign in to Pixvault
login.subtitle: We'll email you a code. No password needed.
login.failed: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.

onboarding.title: Create your team
onboarding.subtitle: A team holds your libraries, members and billing.
onboarding.name: Team name

home.title: Libraries
home.emptyViewer: You haven't been added to a library in this team yet. Ask a team admin.

library.name: Name
library.everyone: Everyone in the team can open it
library.archiveConfirm: Archive "{name}"? It disappears for everyone. Its files stay until retention ends.

settings.maxUpload: Max upload size (MB, empty = plan default)
settings.allowedTypes: Allowed types (e.g. image/*), one per line
settings.ipAllow: IP allow list, one per line
settings.ipBlock: IP block list, one per line

members.title: Members
members.invited: Invitation created. Ask them to sign in to Pixvault with {email}.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

errors.limit: Your plan's library limit is reached.

upload.drop: Drop files here, or click to choose
upload.hint: You can also paste an image. Large files upload in parts and resume if interrupted.
upload.name: Name
upload.dedup: already in this library, no storage used
upload.exists: A file with this name is already in this folder.
upload.purgeConfirm: Delete "{name}" forever? This can't be undone.

links.publicHint: Anyone with the link can see this file.
links.privateHint: Only people in this library can open it. Create a link that expires to share it.
links.copyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the text and copy it
links.propagation: Changes can take up to a minute to reach every location.

review.hint: Files waiting for a decision: moderation flagged them, or they couldn't be checked. Approved files are served as their visibility says; rejected files go to the trash.

reason.tooLarge: Too large to check for location data

browse.dropHint: Uploads go to {folder}. Drop a folder to keep its structure; you can also paste an image.
browse.folderTooBig: Only the first {n} files of that folder were added.
browse.badFolder: Use a path like /campaigns/2026, without '.' or '..'.
browse.partly: {done} done, {failed} couldn't be changed (a name already in use there, or a file that was taken down)
browse.trashFolderConfirm: Move every file in {folder} to the trash and remove the folder?
browse.folderExists: A folder or file with that name is already there.
browse.restoreConfirm: Make version {v} the current one? The current bytes stay as an older version.

live.open: Live: changes by teammates appear here
